comment: Bell as the engine's gate (the owner, 2026-10-01, 06:55 and 07:10: Bell is built as a gate, two simple worlds show the engine works; ALGEBRA.md #the-click-is-the-meeting, the pair's form; HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate): every number of the four worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, their mode files (tools/pixel_mode.py, the packet lay, with --modes) and the blind expectation file, derived from the settings before any run and never touched after. One chain of `length` Nodes (y and z folded) on the universe file `universe` (examples/events/light.json with the pair family added, light's pair at the dimension [2, 1], two real lines never summed at a Node); the pair laid as one event at the column `source`, two packets of the pair family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8) toward +x and -x with the raised-cosine edge `edge_along` along x at the amplitude `amplitude`, the lay the same on both parts (the symmetric lay, UU + LL); one beam to each side, each to one declared region of `screen` Nodes, the chain's first and last, backed by the receding face `receding` (opaque: what enters leaves the declared board and never returns); the side a's region `left` and the side b's `right`, each declaring its setting as its `basis` (p, q) and the pair's `pattern` [[1, 0], [0, 1]] (one integer pair per part, the + port reading the part k as alpha_k p + beta_k q and the - port as alpha_k (-q) + beta_k p: the parts read as (p, q) and (-q, p)); the four worlds the four pairs of `settings`, a and a' on the left, b and b' on the right; `intervals` intervals, the reading over `window`, the whole passage. The reading (tools/bell_gate.py): the engine's `parts` lines, per interval and region the parts' signed level sums, paired through the root and squared, the joint share J over the window on both members of the level pair, E per world, S over the four, the marginal, one pair drawn by the shares with `seed`; beside it the two local credits as the fence (by the parts' shares and by the sign) and the local sums, from the same reports, and r and rho, the parts' mismatch, LATTICE diagnostics never in the blind.
rule: the joint share accumulated over the window on both members of the level pair: J(p_A, p_B) = SUM over the window of (SUM_k c_k now_k^A now_k^B)^2 + (SUM_k c_k before_k^A before_k^B)^2 with c_k = e_k(p_A) e_k(p_B), e(+) = (p, q) the declared basis under the pair's pattern [[1, 0], [0, 1]] and e(-) = (-q, p); E = (J_++ + J_-- - J_+- - J_-+) over the four summed; the window the whole passage, the credit's interval the draw's by the shares over it, one pair per world drawn with the seed; J is a sum of squares and never negative, so no floor is needed (the advisor, #1563 comment 5924731760; the mathematician, #1572 comment 5925374010)

by_the_parts_shares.status: theorem: each part's share credited alone is a product form, E = cos 2a cos 2b, rho = 0, S at most 2; the lower fence

by_the_local_sums.status: theorem: the square of each side's own sum is a product form, E = sin 2a sin 2b, S at most 2; a reader rewritten as a local sum lands here

by_the_sign.status: theorem: the larger port on each side, every outcome the same, E = 1 where neither side ties and 0 where one does, S = 2 exactly; the upper fence of a local credit

blind.efficiency: 1, closed by construction: every pair is credited by the draw
blind.status: theorem under the owner's declaration of the credit (the one form of the click, the meeting): E = ((p p' + q q')^2 - (p q' - q p')^2) / ((p^2 + q^2) (p'^2 + q'^2)) at equal parts, Lagrange's identity, the parts laid equal stepping equal by the determinism of Rule3; a gate of the engine and never a result (HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate)

of_rho.status: derived (the mathematician, #1572 comment 5925175652): E = cos 2a cos 2b + rho sin 2a sin 2b, rho = 2 r / (1 + r^2) the parts' mismatch, 1 at the equal lay; r and rho are the reader's labelled diagnostics and no number of this blind
of_rho.fence: lattice for r and rho, clicks for S
